editorial.title: PolinRider planted malware in Packagist development branches
editorial.summary: Socket researchers found malicious code in development versions of visanduma/nova-two-factor and traced the changes to a compromised developer account. They had not identified a malicious stable release at the time of their report; exposure depends on use of affected development branches or repository content.
editorial.why_it_matters: This campaign can spread through source collaboration before a stable package release. Download totals do not establish how many users ran the malicious code.
editorial.action: Check Composer constraints and lockfiles for dev-main; avoid affected development branches until the repository is confirmed clean. If suspect code ran, investigate affected systems and rotate accessible credentials from a trusted host.
